services.name: Studio Equipment Rental
services.desc: Hot shop rental is available only to experienced glass artists. You will need to provide the following information prior to using our equipment: We operate a Mobile Glassblowing Studios Phoenix furnace. This is a combination furnace/glory hole with a side mounted burner, a 40 lb invested crucible and a side mounted pipe warmer. The working (open door) dimensions are 12″ high by 14″ wide by 19″ deep. The furnace is set up outdoors and fed from a 100 gallon propane tank. Our workspace is covered, but the furnace is exposed, so consider the weather before you book.
